blocks.text: THE HAGUE — Dutch Prime Minister Rob Jetten and his Argentine partner Nicolas Keenan announced on Monday that they were expecting a baby with the help of an egg donor and a surrogate mother. “A very special person is on the way. See you in 2027, little one,” the couple posted on Instagram, next to a photo of them holding a pregnancy scan image. Jetten’s political party, D66, issued a statement saying the pregnancy was made possible by a couple of Dutch friends who already had children.
